cases.title: AI allowance follows billed gateway spend, with a scheduled drift check and alert
cases.text: Goal: make sure no team is ever again refused AI while it is under its real allowance (HTPR-7687 follow-up). Valentin's rule: "it should be based on wahts actually billed through the api ikeys". The allowance check must use what the AI Gateway actually billed for the team. Holds for running calls only keep a call's place while it runs and are replaced by the real cost at the end. Part 1: scheduled drift check A scheduled job compares each active team's allowance counter with the gateway's real spend for the month. It alerts us when the two drift apart by more than a set margin. It also alerts when a team was refused while its real spend is under its allowance. The alert names the team, both numbers and the refusals, never a key. Part 2: count only billed spend Check what HTPR-7687 still counts as spend from our own estimates, such as stopped or unfinished calls, expired holds and the 25 minute wait before the counter is corrected.
